notes.title: Where It All Began - Release Tomorrow
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, 

In the upcoming weeks, I'll release another Steam Dev Log regarding Summer's Gone - Season 2. [/p][p][/p][p]However, today it's about WiAB, which takes place in the same universe.   [/p][p][/p][p]It releases in about 10 hours!   [/p][p][/p][p]It launches with a price tag of 7,99 in early access. ($9.99 after a week.)

Included is the release of Chapter 4. [/p][p]All future Season 1 updates are free of charge. 4 out of 8 Chapters released) [/p][p][/p][p]You can find it here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2965230/Where_it_all_Began__Season_1/" style="button" buttoncolor="#7237fb"]WIAB Steam[/url]

Countdown: [url="https://countingdownto.com/?c=6396699"]https://countingdownto.com/?c=6396699[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Some previews: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/8ae2a9679bcd4b2bad7634853e37cb304f3819f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/b59932e9509f1a73ccd3fb8fc7d378b32b321759.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/6f0240207bd26f1d21ae27ca544a2ce74d7ef2c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/73329dc066c965fd27311ca17168ff2e55553cc3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/c58b70a95b5daf14af16ae3e732ecd70b820ab8b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/badb24e6de51125db95057fd79b437e14c02df48.png"][/img][/p][p]After WiAB's release, it's full focus on the next Summer's Gone Chapter.[/p]

notes.title: Summer's Gone - Season 1 - Release is today!
notes.notes:
Hello, 

Steam's approximate time for the release led to some confusion. This wasn't set by me but by Steam. 

Summer's Gone will be released in around two and a half hours. 6PM GMT+1 (Berlin time) 

Here's an exact countdown: https://www.tickcounter.com/countdown/5247067/summers-gone-steam-release 


- Ocean

notes.title: Release Date - Summer's Gone - Season 1
notes.notes:
Finally, we are here... 

Summer's Gone will be released in less than a week on Friday, the 10th of May. 

It's been one hell of a ride.  


- Ocean
